data.body: Milestone: nonlegal-close-tigermoth (51fa-fd8a-6e47-428f) now closed. Its first completion run correctly refused ambiguous reviewer provenance. The record now distinguishes author session codex:/root/implement_core_test_comments from independent read-only reviewer codex:/root/implement_core_test_comments/review_de77_final_clean, and the acceptance criterion accurately records the one deliberately removed obsolete _TESTS_DIR comment. The necessary plan refresh is certified at merged revision e3743b11121a19a83811d1174ea052c446421f8e; the rerun completion verifier passed and transitioned the leaf closed. Epic progress is exactly 20/117 leaves closed. Filed Gerrit-history bug clippable? no: clumpish-naggish-noolbenger (8c0b-7f16-1ea0-4afc), linked discovered_from the epic, because changes 2809/2810/2812/2817/2821 report MERGED to main while their revisions are not ancestors of current live main; a separate debug session owns it.
